name: Honey Garlic Baked Salmon with Broccoli and Rice

components.name: Honey Garlic Salmon
steps: Whisk honey, soy, garlic and lemon into a glaze. Heat oven to 205 C and line a baking tray.
Coat salmon lightly with glaze, reserving unused glaze separately. Bake fish 12-18 minutes until it reaches 63 C; reheat any glaze contaminated with raw fish until fully boiling before serving.
Brush fully cooked salmon with safe sauce and portion with rice and broccoli; cool shallow containers promptly.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Cook raw rice with measured water in a covered saucepan and allow to rest before fluffing.

components.name: Roasted Broccoli
steps: Toss broccoli with its oil and salt; roast for about 12 minutes before adding fish to a second tray.

Reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard. Use a food thermometer.
When a recipe includes rice, cool it rapidly and store cold immediately; avoid leaving cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Reheat crisp foods in oven when possible.
